title: Tutorial Project
description: Explains how to use this rather minimalist app.
notes:
This application treats tasks as infinitely nest-able objects, meaning you can have a project with tasks that have subtasks, which each have their own subtasks, and so on for as many levels as you need.

If you're reading this, you've already figured out how to go "down" a level.

To go back "up", use the button in the top left with the inverse icon to the one that brought you here.

To add new items, use the plus.

To mark items complete, use the checkbox.

To edit the currently displayed task, use the pencil.

While adding or editing a task via the form, use the save icon to save it and use the X to exit the form without saving.

To delete a task, use the garbage can.
CAUTION: Deleting a task does not ask for confirmation, is irreversible, and will delete all of its subtasks.

Tasks will display ordered by date and then by priority (with 3 being the highest priority), as you can see below.

This tutorial will respawn if the app is closed or refreshed with zero projects.
